H3902.def: from «03899»; foodful; Lachmi, an Israelite; or rather probably a brief form (or perhaps erroneous transcription) for «01022»:-- Lahmi. See also «03433».

H3903.et: probably by erroneous transcription for Lachmam {lakh-mawm'}
H3903.def: probably by erroneous transcription for Lachmam {lakh-mawm'}; from «03899»; food-like; Lachmam or Lachmas, a place in Palestine:--Lahmam.

H3904.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3904.def: (Aramaic) from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a concubine:--concubine.

H3905.def: a primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to distress:--afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress(-or), thrust self.

H3907.def: a primitive root; to whisper; by implication, to mumble a spell (as a magician):--charmer, whisper (together).

H3908.def: from «03907»; properly, a whisper, i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely, an amulet:--charmed, earring, enchantment, orator, prayer.

H3909.et: a form of (03814) or else participle from (03874)
H3909.def: a form of «03814» or else participle from «03874»; properly, covered, i.e. secret; by implication, incantation; also secrecy or (adverb) covertly: -enchantment, privily, secretly, softly.

H3910.def: probably from «03874»; a gum (from its sticky nature), probably ladanum:--myrrh.

H3911.et: from an unused root meaning to hide
H3911.def: from an unused root meaning to hide; a kind of lizard (from its covert habits):--lizard.

H3912.et: masc. pl. of pass participle of (03913)
H3912.def: masculine plural of passive participle of «03913»; hammered (i.e. oppressed) ones; Letushim, an Arabian tribe:--Letushim.

H3913.def: a primitive root; properly, to hammer out (an edge), i.e. to sharpen:--instructer, sharp(-en), whet.

H3915.def: or (Isa. 21:11) leyl {lale}; also laylah {lah'- yel-aw}; from the same as «03883»; properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity:--((mid-))night (season).

H3918.et: from (03888) in the sense of crushing
H3918.def: from «03888» in the sense of crushing; a lion (from his destructive blows):--(old)lion.

H3919.def: the same as «03918»; Laish, the name of two places in Palestine:--Laish. Compare «03889».

H3920.def: a primitive root; to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere:--X at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.

H3921.def: from «03920»; something to capture with, i.e. a noose:--being taken.

H3922.def: from «03212»; a journey; Lekah, a place in Palestine: -Lecah.

H3923.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3923.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lakish, a place in Palestine:--Lachish.

H3924.def: from the same as «03883»; a loop:--loop.

H3925.def: a primitive root; properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive):(un-) accustomed, × diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach(-er, - ing).

H3926.et: aprol. and separable form of the prepositional prefix
H3926.def: a prol. and separable form of the prepositional prefix; to or for:--at, for, to, upon.

H3927.def: or Lmow el {lem-o-ale'}; from «03926» and «0410»; (belonging) to God; Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon: -Lemuel.

H3928.def: or limmud {lim-mood'}; from «03925»; instructed: -accustomed, disciple, learned, taught, used.

H3929.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3929.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs:--Lamech.

H3932.def: a primitive root; to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly:--have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering.

H3934.def: from «03932»; a buffoon; also a foreigner:--mocker, stammering.

H3935.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3935.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Ladah, an Israelite:--Laadah.

H3936.def: from the same as «03935»; Ladan, the name of two Israelites:--Laadan.

H3937.def: a primitive root; to speak in a foreign tongue: -strange language.

H3938.def: a primitive root; to swallow greedily; causatively, to feed:--feed.

H3939.et: from an unused root supposed to mean to curse
H3939.def: from an unused root supposed to mean to curse; wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed):--hemlock, wormwood.

H3940.et: from an unused root probably meaning to shine
H3940.def: or lappid {lap-peed'}; from an unused root probably meaning to shine; a flambeau, lamp or flame:--(fire-)brand, (burning) lamp, lightning, torch.

H3941.def: feminine plural of «03940»; Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah:--Lappidoth.

H3942.et: from the prepositional prefix (to or for) and (06440)
H3942.def: from the prepositional prefix (to or for) and «06440»; anterior:--before.

H3943.def: a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside:--take hold, turn aside (self).

H3946.et: from an unused root thought to mean to stop up by a barricade
H3946.def: from an unused root thought to mean to stop up by a barricade; perhaps fortification; Lakkum, a place in Palestine:--Lakum.

H3947.def: a primitive root; to take (in the widest variety of applications):--accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, × many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

H3948.def: from «03947»; properly, something received, i.e. (mentally) instruction (whether on the part of the teacher or hearer); also (in an active and sinister sense) inveiglement:--doctrine, learning, fair speech.

H3950.def: a primitive root; properly, to pick up, i.e. (generally) to gather; specifically, to glean:--gather (up), glean.

H3952.def: a primitive root; to lick or lap:--lap, lick.

H3953.def: a primitive root; to gather the after crop:--gather.

H3955.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3955.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; apparently juice, i.e. (figuratively) vigor; also a sweet or fat cake:--fresh, moisture.

H3956.def: or lashon {law-shone'}; also (in plural) feminine lshonah {lesh-o-naw'}; from «03960»; the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water):--+ babbler,bay, + evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge.

H3957.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3957.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging):--chamber, parlour. Compare «05393».

H3958.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3958.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a gem, perhaps the jacinth:--ligure.

H3959.def: the same as «03958»; Leshem, a place in Palestine: -Leshem.

H3960.def: a primitive root; properly, to lick; but used only as a denominative from «03956»; to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate:--accuse, slander.

H3961.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03956»; speech, i.e. a nation:--language.

H3962.et: from an unused root thought to mean to break through
H3962.def: from an unused root thought to mean to break through; a boiling spring; Lesha, a place probably East of the Jordan:--Lasha.

H3963.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H3963.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a measure for things dry:--half homer.

H3966.def: from the same as «0181»; properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated):--diligently, especially, exceeding(-ly), far, fast, good, great(-ly), × louder and louder, might(-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very (+ much, sore), well.

H3967.et: properly, a primitive numeral; a hundred
H3967.def: or metyah {may-yaw'}; properly, a primitive numeral; a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction:--hundred((-fold), -th), + sixscore.

H3968.def: the same as «03967»; Meah, a tower in Jerusalem:--Meah.

H3971.et: as if passive participle from an unused root
H3971.def: usually muwm {moom}; as if passive participle from an unused root probably meaning to stain; a blemish (physically or morally):--blemish, blot, spot.

H3972.def: apparently a form of «03971»; properly, a speck or point, i.e. (by implication) something; with negative, nothing:--fault, + no(-ught), ought, somewhat, any ((no-))thing.

H3974.def: or maor {maw-ore'}; also (in plural) feminine mpowrah {meh-o-raw'}; or morah {meh-o-raw'}; from «0215»; properly, a luminous body or luminary, i.e. (abstractly) light (as an element): figuratively, brightness, i.e.cheerfulness; specifically, a chandelier:--bright, light.

H3975.def: feminine passive participle of «0215»; something lighted, i.e. an aperture; by implication, a crevice or hole (of a serpent):--den.

H3976.def: from «0239»; (only in the dual) a pair of scales: -balances.

H3978.def: from «0398»; an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit):--food, fruit, ((bake-)) meat(-s), victual.

H3979.def: from «0398»; something to eat with,- i.e. a knife:--knife.

H3980.def: from «0398»; something eaten (by fire), i.e. fuel:--fuel.

H3982.def: from «0559»; something (authoritatively) said, i.e. an edict:--commandment, decree.

H3984.et: probably from a root corresponding to (0579) in the sense of an inclosure by sides
H3984.def: (Aramaic) probably from a root corresponding to «0579» in the sense of an inclosure by sides; a utensil:--vessel.

H3985.def: a primitive root; to refuse:--refuse, × utterly.

H3988.def: a primitive root; to spurn; also (intransitively) to disappear:--abhor, cast away (off), contemn, despise, disdain, (become) loathe(some), melt away, refuse, reject, reprobate, × utterly, vile person.

H3989.def: from «0644»; something baked, i.e. a batch: -baken.

H3990.def: from the same as «0651»; something opaque: -darkness.

H3992.def: a primitive root; to be bitter or (causatively) to embitter, i.e. be painful:--fretting, picking.

H3993.def: from «0693»; an ambuscade:--lie in ambush, ambushment, lurking place, lying in wait.

H3995.def: from «0914»; a separation, i.e. (concretely) a separate place:--separate.

H3996.def: from «0935»; an entrance (the place or the act); specifically (with or without «08121») sunset or the west; also (adverb with preposition) towards:--by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, + westward. Compare «04126».

H3999.et: from (02986) in the sense of flowing
H3999.def: from «02986» in the sense of flowing; a deluge: -flood.
